description.value: Express News Convenience is a BC-born convenience store franchise founded in 1998, now operating 30+ locations across British Columbia. This Burnaby location sits at unit P25-04 on Lougheed Highway — the compact store format (typically 200–1,500 sq ft) is intentionally placed in high-traffic hubs like SkyTrain stations and malls for quick, in-and-out stops. Cyclists can expect grab-and-go essentials: cold drinks, fresh bean-to-cup coffee, snacks, sandwiches, pastries, and lottery tickets.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (32 spaces, covered) at 30m; rack (6 spaces) at 40m; stands (22 spaces, covered) at 89m. Total: 60 spaces.
